seoTitle: Text Diff Checker — Line and Character Differences
description: Compare two pieces of text and highlight differences line by line. Runs entirely in your browser so your content stays private.
intro: Paste two versions of text and see which lines were added, removed or changed. Useful for reviewing edits, code snippets or documents without uploading anything.
blurb: Spot differences between two texts instantly — free, private, no sign-up.

howItWorks: Paste the original text on the left and the modified version on the right.

Added, removed and changed lines are marked so you can review the edits.
examples: Review changes to a paragraph or README.
Compare two versions of a configuration snippet.
Check student essay revisions or code comments.

faq.a: Lines that exist only in the original are marked removed, lines only in the modified text are marked added, and matching lines are shown as unchanged.
No. The comparison runs entirely in your browser using plain JavaScript. Your text never leaves your device.
